content: Hello, this is Rachel from the Amazon Legal Compliance Department. Am I speaking with Mr. Porter?
Yes, this is Alex Porter. How can I help you?
Thank you, Mr. Porter. I'm reaching out regarding a delayed shipment on your recent Amazon order. We noticed an issue with the delivery, and I want to ensure everything's resolved for you.
Oh, I was expecting a camera lens today. What happened?
I completely understand your concern. To clarify, the order is held because of a new Amazon policy, Policy 47-B on international regulatory fees. It's a standard procedure and nothing to worry about.
I've never heard of that before. Is this something new? I really need that lens for my work.

Yes, sir, it's a recent change affecting many sellers and customers. To proceed, I'll need to confirm your delivery address and the last four digits of your Amazon account number, just for verification.
Sure. The address is 1297 Glenwood Ave, Suite 4B. The last four of my account is 9321.

Thank you, Mr. Porter. That matches our records. Now, according to Policy 47-B, a temporary customs regulatory fee of $186 is required to release your shipment. This fee is fully refundable to your account within 24 hours after confirmation.
That's a lot. Can't you just deduct it from my card on file?

I wish it were that simple. Amazon's compliance regulations require the fee to be processed separately as a security measure. We accept Amazon gift card codes, or alternatively, you can use Zelle or a verified crypto wallet.
I'm not sure I understand. Why can't this just go through Amazon like usual purchases?

That's a great question, Mr. Porter. The policy is in place to prevent unauthorized transactions and to comply with new federal guidelines. Rest assured, your payment is temporary and will be credited back as soon as your order clears customs.
If I use an Amazon gift card, how do I send you the code?

Excellent, thank you for being so cooperative. Once you purchase a gift card for the required amount, simply read the claim code to me or enter it in the secure payment portal I'll provide. This ensures your order is prioritized.
Okay, so I just buy a $186 gift card and give you the code?
Correct, sir. Or, if it's easier, you can make two smaller gift cards totaling $186. Please let me know which you prefer so I can guide you step by step.
I'll get two cards. Do you need anything else from me?
Just to ensure your account is credited properly, can you confirm your best phone number and the email associated with your Amazon account?
My number is 555-0198 and my email is alex.porter@freelanceworks.com.
Thank you, Mr. Porter. Please let me know as soon as you've purchased the gift cards, and I'll walk you through the final step. I'll stay on the line to assist you.
Alright, I'm heading to the store now. How long do I have before the order is canceled?
No worries, your order is secure for the next 90 minutes. I'll make sure there are no penalties as long as we complete the process soon.
Thank you. I really appreciate your help. This is a bit stressful.
Absolutely, Mr. Porter. My job is to help you and make sure you don't experience any inconvenience. Once you have the codes, just let me know and I'll handle the rest.
I've got the cards. Ready for the codes?
Yes, please provide the codes one at a time, and I'll confirm each as received.
First code: 8XQ9-LK24-MNPT-4Y5C.
Received, thank you. And the second code?
Second code: 2TQ7-ML16-KVWD-9G3A.

Excellent, both codes are verified. Your shipment will be released within the next two hours, and your refund will be processed shortly. You'll receive a confirmation email at alex.porter@freelanceworks.com.
Will I get a tracking update too?
Yes, you'll receive both a tracking update and a refund confirmation. Thank you for your prompt cooperation, Mr. Porter. Please let us know if you have further questions.
